## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any limitations. Use synthetic credentials and mocked HTTP; do not test live writes or send real messages.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility changes, documentation updates, or follow-up work when relevant.

- [ ] I reviewed CONTRIBUTING.md and the relevant AGENTS.md invariants.
- [ ] I added regression coverage for behavior changes, or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and the Unreleased changelog for behavior changes.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private configuration, or personal academic data.
